All finiteness, normalization and endpoint conventions are explicit, and the standalone script was executed with VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The \((4,4,4)\) case is the first balanced all-four-alphabet instance beyond the (3,3,3) proven cases of an explicit literature conjecture and is not a textbook consequence: the actual complex has 830101 faces and a three-way maximal-facet taxonomy (12 coordinate planes, 64 balls, 432 parity tetrahedra). A complete integral homotopy certificate establishes a previously unproved natural conjectural cutoff, and the metric filtration yields exact 63/81/405 persistent ranks. Value does not rely on code correctness, mere novelty, a tiny numerical increment, or any claimed all-parameter theorem; it rests on a canonical fixed case of an open family with a nontrivial complete proof and reproducible finite taxonomy.
